Query: SELECT `l`.`id` AS `livestream_id`,COALESCE(`r`.`total_reactions`, N) + COALESCE(`lc`.`total_tip`, N) AS `score`,COALESCE(`r`.`total_reactions`, N) AS `total_reactions`,COALESCE(`lc`.`max_tip`, N) AS `max_tip` FROM (`livestreams` AS `l` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `livestream_id`,COUNT(N) AS `total_reactions` FROM `reactions` GROUP BY `livestream_id`) AS `r` ON `r`.`livestream_id` = `l`.`id`) LEFT JOIN (SELECT `livestream_id`,SUM(`tip`) AS `total_tip`,MAX(`tip`) AS `max_tip` FROM `livecomments` GROUP BY `livestream_id`) AS `lc` ON `lc`.`livestream_id` = `l`.`id`

SELECT `u`.`name` AS `username`,COALESCE(`r`.`total_reactions`, N) + COALESCE(`lc`.`total_tip`, N) AS `score`,COALESCE(`r`.`total_reactions`, N) AS `total_reactions`,COALESCE(`lc`.`total_livecomments`, N) AS `total_livecomments`,COALESCE(`lc`.`total_tip`, N) AS `total_tip` FROM (`users` AS `u` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `l`.`user_id`,COUNT(N) AS `total_reactions` FROM `livestreams` AS `l` JOIN `reactions` AS `r` ON `r`.`livestream_id` = `l`.`id` GROUP BY `l`.`user_id`) AS `r` ON `r`.`user_id` = `u`.`id`) LEFT JOIN (SELECT `l`.`user_id`,COUNT(N) AS `total_livecomments`,SUM(`lc`.`tip`) AS `total_tip` FROM `livestreams` AS `l` JOIN `livecomments` AS `lc` ON `lc`.`livestream_id` = `l`.`id` GROUP BY `l`.`user_id`) AS `lc` ON `lc`.`user_id` = `u`.`id`
UPDATE `reservation_slots` SET `slot`=`slot` - N WHERE `start_at` >= N AND `start_at` < N AND `end_at` <= N
